A.title: Eligible job opportunities
A.definition: Vehicle-period population times job eligibility and incidence, before dealer choice.

B.title: Completed dealer capture
B.definition: Share of eligible jobs actually completed at the relevant Auto2000 entity, after customer decisions and operational handoffs.

C.title: Contribution per completed job
C.definition: Job revenue less the direct costs recognized in gross profit, including product/work mix and actual payer. Each cost is assigned once.

D.title: Additional cost, displacement and risk
D.definition: Counterfactual resource, capacity and risk checks. Operating costs below gross profit remain separate; displacement already reflected in completed volumes is not subtracted again.

limits: MECE for accounting categories under a stated business perimeter, not causal independence or exhaustive knowledge.
